source.author: verg
source.text: Tum regina deum caelo delapsa morantis impulit ipsa manu portas, et cardine verso belli ferratos rumpit Saturnia postes.
source.text_original: Tum regina deum caelo delapsa morantis / impulit ipsa manu portas, et cardine verso / belli ferratos rumpit Saturnia postes.
source.text_english: Then the queen of the gods, having descended from heaven, herself with her hand drove open the lingering gates, and, the hinge turned, Saturnian Juno bursts the iron-bound doorposts of war.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tum validam contorto turbine portam impulit Hippotades.
reuse.text_original: tum validam contorto turbine portam / impulit Hippotades.
reuse.text_english: Then Hippotas’ son drove against the stout gate with a whirling blast.
